_doc: GIN inner-validation 설계 사전 확정. docs/66 §2·§3. gin_seed_freeze.json·ladder_freeze.json 무수정(별도 동결).

already_frozen_not_newly_chosen.checkpoint_update_rule: strict greater-than on validation macro AP (train_ladder.py:237)
already_frozen_not_newly_chosen.tie_break: earliest epoch wins, as an automatic consequence of the strict inequality; no new rule introduced
already_frozen_not_newly_chosen.best_state_restore: load best_state before predicting the outer test fold
already_frozen_not_newly_chosen.monitor: validation macro AP over PTs with at least one in-sample positive; identical in definition to sap.metrics.macro_ap(eligible_pt=None), since the eligible set (global positives >= 10) is all 370 columns

inner_split.unit_of_split: Bemis-Murcko scaffold group; the empty-string scaffold (ring-free or unparseable) counts as one legitimate group, identically to the registered outer split
inner_split.fraction_rationale: Inherited from the development split 873/109/110, whose valid share of the non-test pool is 109/982 = 0.11100, matching 1/9 = 0.11111 to three decimals. Not a newly invented quantity.
inner_split.algorithm: Reuse of the registered outer-split algorithm (confirmatory_oof_rep1.assign_folds) generalized to two unequal buckets: (1) pre-sort groups by (-group_size, str(first row index)), where the row index is the position in the frozen master_X/master_Y ascending-cid order and the outer-train subset is NOT re-indexed; (2) random.Random(inner_seed).shuffle; (3) cuts = [n_outer_train/9, n_outer_train], assign each group to the first bucket whose running total still fits, else to the last bucket; bucket 0 = inner-valid, bucket 1 = inner-train.
inner_split.shared_across: one inner split per (split_seed, fold_index); shared by all seven GIN ladder models and all five training seeds
asserts: zero eligible PTs with no positives in inner-train (registration section 6 rare-PT constraint)

feature_block_fit_population.population: the FULL outer-train fold, inner-valid rows included — identical to the RF confirmatory harness
feature_block_fit_population.rationale: Registration section 5 permits fitting scalers, PCA and aggregation statistics on the fold's train/valid; confirmatory_oof_rep1.py:499-509 fits RF blocks on the entire outer-train. Using the same population keeps the input representation identical across families for the same rung.

rf_asymmetry.fact: RF trains on the full outer-train (873-874 drugs); GIN trains on inner-train only (776-777 drugs), i.e. 11.1% fewer rows, because the frozen A_wd recipe requires early stopping on a held-out validation set while RF is deterministic.
rf_asymmetry.decision: accept and disclose; no refit-on-full-outer-train equalization
rf_asymmetry.rejected_alternative: select the epoch on inner-valid then refit on the full outer-train — rejected because it roughly doubles GIN training (357 to 714 runs), adds the untested assumption that an epoch chosen at one training-set size transfers to another, and removes the early-stopping safeguard during the refit
rf_asymmetry.limitation_to_report: RQ-int compares Delta_RF with Delta_GIN while the two families train on sample sizes differing by 11.1%. If the smaller training set suppresses the GIN model's ability to exploit sequence features, Delta_GIN may shrink and be misread as a family difference. The asymmetry is structural, and was fixed and disclosed before any GIN result was seen.

known_quirk.observation: its inner-valid holds 97 drugs in only 15 scaffold groups, 77 of which come from the empty-string pseudo-group, so its early-stopping monitor rests on 15 clusters dominated by one
known_quirk.handling: rule left unchanged; disclosed as a limitation. Excluding large groups from the validation bucket would be a post-hoc adjustment and would contradict the registered treatment of that pseudo-group.

corrections_vs_prompt_json.now: pre-sort groups by (-group_size, str(first row index)), where the row index is the position in the frozen master_X/master_Y ascending-cid order and the outer-train subset is NOT re-indexed
corrections_vs_prompt_json.why: assign_folds 의 groups 는 scaffold → **행 인덱스** 리스트이므로 groups[g][0] 은 cid 가 아니라 행 인덱스다. 'first cid' 로 구현하면 셔플 초기순서가 달라져 **다른 inner split** 이 나오고 docs/66 §4 표를 재현하지 못한다(15 unit 중 1 unit 만 우연 일치). 'first row index' 해석은 동결 outer split 을 3반복 전건 0행 불일치로 재현해 검증했다. 설계값 변경이 아니라 재현 불가 문구의 교정이다.
A_wd 레시피 상수 줄은 실측 61(SEEDS)~67(EPOCHS…)이다. 61-63 은 EPOCHS/PATIENCE 줄(67)을 포함하지 않는다. 236-248(monitor·갱신조건·best state 복원)은 실측 일치.
